# awscc_quicksight_agent (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::QuickSight::Agent



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `action_connectors` (List of String) A list of ActionConnector ARNs (max 10) attached to the agent.
- `agent_id` (String) The unique identifier for the agent.
- `agent_lifecycle` (String) The lifecycle stage of the agent. PREVIEW or PUBLISHED.
- `agent_status` (String) The current status of the agent. One of ACTIVE, CREATING, UPDATING, or FAILED.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the agent.
- `aws_account_id` (String) The ID of the Amazon Web Services account where the agent is being created.
- `created_at` (String) The date and time the agent was created.
- `creator` (String) The ARN of the user who created the agent.
- `custom_prompt_input` (Attributes) Custom prompt configuration. Specify either ExistingPrompt or NewPrompt. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_prompt_input))
- `custom_prompt_interface` (Attributes) Read-only view of the resolved custom prompt interface for the agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_prompt_interface))
- `description` (String) A description of the agent.
- `error_message` (String) The error message if the agent is in FAILED status.
- `icon_id` (String) The icon identifier for the agent.
- `name` (String) The display name of the agent.
- `spaces` (List of String) A list of Space ARNs (max 10) attached to the agent.
- `starter_prompts` (List of String) A list of up to 3 starter prompts displayed to users.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of key-value pairs to associate with the agent resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time the agent was last updated.
- `welcome_message` (String) The welcome message displayed when a user opens the agent.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_prompt_input"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_prompt_input`

Read-Only:

- `existing_prompt` (Attributes) Reference to an existing custom prompt profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_prompt_input--existing_prompt))
- `new_prompt` (Attributes) Parameters for creating a new custom prompt configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_prompt_input--new_prompt))

<a id="nestedatt--custom_prompt_input--existing_prompt"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_prompt_input.existing_prompt`

Read-Only:

- `model_profile_id` (String) The identifier of the model profile.
- `qbs_aws_account_id` (String) The QBS AWS account identifier.
- `subscription_id` (String) The subscription identifier.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_prompt_input--new_prompt"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_prompt_input.new_prompt`

Read-Only:

- `custom_instructions` (String) Custom instructions for the agent behavior.
- `identity` (String) The identity or persona of the agent.
- `output_style` (String) The output style for the agent responses.
- `response_length` (String) The desired response length for the agent.
- `tone` (String) The tone used in agent responses.

Read-Only:

- `model_profile_id` (String) The identifier of the model profile.
- `output_style` (String) The output style for the agent responses.
- `prompt_summary` (String) A summary of the resolved prompt.
- `qbs_aws_account_id` (String) The QBS AWS account identifier.
